operational-example.copy: Use Tooltip for short contextual help that clarifies an icon, metric, disabled control, or unfamiliar operational term without moving the user away from the current task.

scenario.title: Fleet dashboard helper layer
scenario.meta: Short explanations anchored to controls and metrics

items.label: Fuel efficiency compares this fleet against the last 30 days.
Export is unavailable until a date range is selected.
Grid shows column rhythm for layout review.

rationale: Tooltip clarifies a nearby object without becoming navigation or a decision surface.
The trigger keeps the accessible name; the tooltip adds description.
The message stays short enough to disappear safely on blur, escape, or pointer leave.

items.rule: Owns focus, hover, and aria-describedby connection.
Points to the trigger when space allows and never replaces placement logic.
Positions the bubble near the trigger while avoiding viewport edges.
Uses a quick fade and lift that respects reduced motion.

accessibility.statePrecedence: disabled, dismissed, open, focus, hover, default
items: Connect the trigger and tooltip with aria-describedby when the tooltip is visible.
Show on focus and hover; dismiss on blur, pointer leave, Escape, or scroll context changes.
Keep tooltip content non-interactive; use Popover when the layer contains controls.
Do not hide required instructions exclusively inside a tooltip.
Keep the trigger accessible name independent from the tooltip copy.

variants.copy: Tooltip variants describe why the explanation appears: default helper copy, icon-only clarification, metric definitions, and disabled-control rationale.

demos.label: Cost per km includes toll and fuel movement data.
Driver assignment is unavailable until a driver exists.

states.copy: Tooltip states are ephemeral. Default is hidden, hover and focus open the bubble, disabled-help explains unavailable controls, and reduced motion removes lift without removing clarity.

demos.label: Default tooltip is hidden until the trigger receives hover or focus.
Hover opens the helper without changing trigger meaning.
Focus opens the helper for keyboard users.
Open keeps the bubble visible for documentation and testing.
Disabled actions may expose why the action is unavailable.
Dismissed removes the bubble and leaves the trigger available.

variant-state-behavior.copy: Variant defines the explanation purpose; state defines whether the bubble is visible. Tooltip never holds selection, input, or navigation state.

demo.label: Pick a date range before export.

full-width.copy: Tooltip does not stretch. The trigger follows its parent layout, while the bubble keeps a readable max width and wraps short copy.

demo.label: Export is unavailable until at least one row is ready.

responsive-layout-patterns.copy: Responsive tooltip use depends on input mode: desktop can rely on hover and focus, while touch contexts need a visible trigger and may escalate to Popover for longer help.

demos.label: Card limit resets at 00:00 local time.

viewport-organization.copy: Keep tooltips close to the trigger and away from edges. When small viewports cannot guarantee readable placement, promote the explanation to inline helper text or Popover.

items.title: Phone
items.rule: Use explicit help triggers and bottom placement when the anchor is near the topbar.

items.title: Tablet
items.rule: Keep bubbles short and allow side placement only when the column has room.

items.title: Desktop
items.rule: Use hover and focus for dense toolbars, icon buttons, table headers, and metric definitions.

playground.copy: Use the playground to verify short copy, trigger label, placement, variant, and visibility state before placing Tooltip in dense UI.

api-foundations.copy: Tooltip API exposes trigger association, copy, placement, variant, state, delay, and optional icon while Design System foundations own layer color, motion, proximity, dismissal, and accessible description.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.notes: Called when local open state changes.

props.name: variant
props.notes: Purpose variant: default, icon-help, metric, or disabled-help.

props.name: density
props.notes: Controls trigger and bubble scale for sm, md, and lg contexts.

props.name: state
props.notes: Visibility state for default, hover, focus, open, disabled, or dismissed.

props.name: disabled
props.notes: Disables the trigger while keeping optional help visible when appropriate.

groups.title: Use
items: Clarify icons, metrics, table headers, disabled actions, and unfamiliar terms.
Keep copy under one short sentence.
Use aria-describedby only while the tooltip is visible.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Do not put actions, destinations, fields, or rich content inside Tooltip.
Do not hide required instructions only in Tooltip.
Do not use Tooltip for error recovery or confirmation.

groups.title: Review
items: Confirm hover, focus, Escape, and blur behavior.
Escalate to Popover when copy needs interaction or more than one sentence.

mustTest: Tooltip is connected with aria-describedby when visible
Hover and focus open the bubble
Escape or blur dismisses the bubble
Placement does not create viewport overflow
rejectIf: Tooltip copy is required to complete the task.
Tooltip appears without a visible or focusable trigger.
Tooltip uses raw color, shadow, spacing, or motion values.

miel.copy: MIEL treats Tooltip as short contextual explanation attached to a trigger: agents can add it when the object is already understandable, while humans confirm whether the help should be visible inline, moved to Popover, or removed.
canDecide: Use Tooltip for one-sentence clarification of icons, metrics, disabled controls, and unfamiliar terms.
Keep Tooltip non-interactive and anchored to one trigger.
Prefer top or bottom placement unless the viewport gives enough side space.
mustAsk: The explanation is required for task completion.
The layer needs actions, destinations, fields, images, or multiple paragraphs.
The trigger has no stable accessible name or the placement could collide with critical UI.
rejectIf: Tooltip replaces inline helper text, validation, Toast, Popover, or Dialog.
Tooltip is only available to pointer users.
miel.handoff: I am using Tooltip for short contextual help. I need confirmation that the copy is optional, the trigger is accessible, and the message does not need a Popover or inline helper treatment.
